BS8-059#46.effectText: 【Activate】 【Once Per Turn】 <{G}> <Return 2 {G} cards from your support area to your hand.> If another [Mystic Flour Cookie] is not in your battle area, place up to 2 cards from the top of each of your opponent's Cookies' HP into the trash.

BS7-056#47.name: Sting Durian Cookie
BS7-056#47.effectText: If there is a {G} 【Arena】 Cookie in your battle area, the LV.2 or higher Cookie with this card attached for HP gains +1 HP.
